QuestInfo.name: [Guild Castle] Alone in the Charred Ruins
QuestInfo.0: You hear a #bfaint voice#k calling you from somewhere.
QuestInfo.1: Following a faint voice and a strange energy, you arrived at a scorched castle. There, you met an old gentleman named #bBenedict#k and his presumed son, #bJack#k.
QuestInfo.2: Jack is crying and hugging Benedict, who seems to have lost his mind. See what you can do for Jack first.
